scope: P0 historical Seoul area/sales/store, 2022Q1..2023Q2, preflight ONLY; no production dimension or fact loads

status_definitions.READY_TO_DESIGN: Meaning and target grain are documented; it is NOT permission to INSERT
status_definitions.CONDITIONAL: Additional empirical verification required before materialization
status_definitions.BLOCKED: Missing authoritative evidence or model support; INSERT forbidden

gates.subject: DIM_PERIOD reporting-quarter records
gates.required_evidence: Six distinct valid YYYYQ codes; Gregorian quarter ranges; determine period_end_date inclusive/exclusive convention and unit in catalog
gates.resolution: Generate 2022Q1..2023Q2 reference rows in future approved load, not during 3-5-1

gates.subject: DIM_AREA area boundary version & valid-time
gates.required_evidence: Authoritative published source-area version, effective_start_date and boundaries/historical mapping for archived 2022-2023 codes; official 2024 spatial standard-unit change
gates.resolution: Retrieve dated 2022/2023 SHP + metadata/history; verify each CSV area_code and polygons; document [start,end) without invented dates

gates.subject: DIM_INDUSTRY classification version & effective-start
gates.required_evidence: Official Seoul 100 service sector taxonomy codebook with date/version applicable 2022Q1..2023Q2; 63 sales industries subset of 100 store industries
gates.resolution: Acquire historical taxonomy, check 100 codes+names vs official version and SCD validity; no ad hoc version/date

gates.subject: DIM_AREA_TYPE, DIM_DISTRICT and DIM_DONG codes
gates.required_evidence: AREA source code->name consistency against official codebook and validity at time of source; keep identifiers as strings
gates.resolution: Prepare read-only distinct mappings; verify authority and code revisions before writing any DIM

gates.subject: FACT_AREA_SALES grain
gates.required_evidence: 125692 unique (quarter,area_code,industry_code) keys; quarterly estimated sales unit KRW; precise area+industry SCD lookup at reporting interval
gates.resolution: Require G02,G03 and period-date rule; check FK version covers entire quarter or formally agreed as-of rule; no duplicate natural grain

gates.subject: FACT_AREA_STORE reporting vs observation period
gates.required_evidence: Quarterly source code exists but NO distinct observation period field in archived CSV; observation_period_key NOT NULL in DDL
gates.resolution: Obtain official store metric snapshot/observation period semantics and codebook; do not silently reuse reporting period_key

gates.subject: FACT_AREA_STORE rate & count constraints
gates.required_evidence: Apply and confirm migration 004 in actual MySQL; preserve rates>100 (opening 5,closure 124,128 distinct rows); DECIMAL(12,6) fit; BIGINT counts nonnegative
gates.resolution: Check information_schema CHECK clause, don't trust P0 initial 0..100 text; add rate/amount precision QA prior to planned load

gates.subject: STORE-SALES coverage policy
gates.required_evidence: 331351 STORE grain keys have no SALES row (not zero); SALE keys are a subset of STORE keys
gates.resolution: LEFT JOIN store->sales; NULL missing sales; do not synthesize 331351 sales FACTs

gates.subject: WARN/REVIEW conversion vs business metric gating
gates.required_evidence: Current quality STG: ACCEPT 435364, WARN 123587, REVIEW 25434; issue-level exemptions explicit; detailed 14 rules partially implemented
gates.resolution: Define per-target-field exception matrix; REVIEW for area missing time blocks DIM, but sales detailed time-bin issues do not imply total amount invalid

gates.subject: Lineage id and reprocessing semantics
gates.required_evidence: DIM/FACT lineage_group_id VARCHAR NOT NULL but no FK to SRC or STG; source batch/doc/path trace immutable
gates.resolution: Define lineage registry/bridge and deterministic idempotent upsert; lineage_group_id cannot be fabricated

gates.subject: SCD Type 2 temporal overlap and join cardinality
gates.required_evidence: Current-row uniqueness alone not enough; no DB range-exclusion of historical overlapping [start,end) intervals
gates.resolution: Test no overlap per area_code/industry_code, at most one matching SCD row per measure quarter, no boundary crossing without policy

gates.subject: FTC to Seoul industry / region interoperability
gates.required_evidence: No verified category code crosswalk/FTC geographic grain; outside P0 Seoul-only validation
gates.resolution: Do not create FTC DIM_FRANCHISE.industry_key or cross-provider FACT joins from string similarity
